DeterminationBasis: T16-009 establishes that every mandatory requirement applicable to the declared conformance profile and scope receives exactly one permitted conformance status. It explicitly rejects statusless requirements, multiple simultaneous statuses and unrecognised statuses. This directly satisfies the MATR-003 obligation that each applicable mandatory requirement have one determination status.

Existing T14 controls preserve frozen identity, predecessor-successor lineage, correction classification and collision integrity, but no existing T14 test requires the candidate standard byte length to be explicitly recorded. A dedicated freeze-metadata byte-length recording control is therefore required.
